full_text:
Article 6 (Review of Regulations)
The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the appropriateness of the qualifications and size requirements for evaluating agencies under Article 4 every three years, taking January 1, 2024 as the reference date (meaning before January 1 of each third year), and take measures such as improvements.
